character.name: Scrapbot
character.description: a battered scrap-metal robot cobbled together from mismatched salvaged parts, dented rusty plating, one mismatched glowing eye, patched-up joints with visible bolts and welds, clutching a huge tangled bundle of long wires and cables in its claw-like hands as if it just yanked them out of a scrapheap, more loose wires trailing off and looping around its body

style: Classic hand-drawn 2D theatrical cartoon style, expressive exaggerated poses, squash-and-stretch animation aesthetics, bold clean outlines, vintage cel shading, playful slapstick character design.
